#include <iostream>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;

const long long mod = 998244353;

struct Matrix {
    long long mat[2][2];
    Matrix() : mat{{0,0},{0,0}} {}
    Matrix(long long a, long long b, long long c, long long d) {
        mat[0][0] = a; mat[0][1] = b;
        mat[1][0] = c; mat[1][1] = d;
    }
    Matrix(const Matrix& other) {
        for(int i=0;i<2;i++) for(int j=0;j<2;j++) mat[i][j] = other.mat[i][j];
    }
    Matrix& operator=(const Matrix& other) {
        for(int i=0;i<2;i++) for(int j=0;j<2;j++) mat[i][j] = other.mat[i][j];
        return *this;
    }
    Matrix mult(const Matrix& m) const {
        Matrix res;
        for(int i=0;i<2;i++) {
            for(int j=0;j<2;j++) {
                long long sum = 0;
                for(int k=0;k<2;k++) {
                    sum = (sum + mat[i][k] * m.mat[k][j]) % mod;
                }
                res.mat[i][j] = sum;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }
    Matrix pow(long long x) const {
        Matrix res(1,0,0,1);
        Matrix a = *this;
        while(x > 0) {
            if(x & 1) res = res.mult(a);
            a = a.mult(a);
            x >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
};

long long pow_mod(long long a, long long b) {
    long long res = 1;
    while(b > 0) {
        if(b & 1) res = (res * a) % mod;
        a = (a * a) % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

int main() {
    long long n, m, L, R;
    cin >> n >> m >> L >> R;
    long long total = n * m;
    if((n & 1) && (m & 1)) {
        cout << pow_mod((R - L + 1) % mod, total) << endl;
    } else {
        long long diff = R - L + 1;
        if((diff & 1) == 0) {
            long long allbutone = pow_mod(diff % mod, total - 1);
            long long res = allbutone * (diff / 2) % mod;
            cout << res << endl;
        } else {
            long long k = diff / 2;
            Matrix mat(k, k+1, k+1, k);
            Matrix res = mat.pow(total);
            cout << res.mat[0][0] << endl;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
